idea-plugin.description:
Inspect Apache Iceberg and Apache Paimon table metadata without leaving the IDE.

Right-click a table directory in the Project view and choose Open in Iceberg Lens, or open the tool window and pick one. The graph walks table → metadata → snapshots → manifests → data files, and the inspector shows what each artifact records against what its contents actually add up to.

Read-only. Nothing is written to the table.

action.description: Inspect this Iceberg or Paimon table's metadata
